item.title: ARISO takes next steps to build new rail technical standards body
item.description: These new appointments mark the implementation of a decision by members at ARISO’s Annual General Meeting (AGM) in November 2025. Image: ARISOThe Australian Rail Industry Standards Organisation (ARISO) has welcomed Matt Longland, Steve Butcher, Sally Stannard and Jeroen Weimar to its board. The new members join chair Dr Gillian Miles and directors Dr Tim Kuypers and Tony Braxton-Smith, who will collectively form ARISO’s board for a two-year transition period from 1 February 2026. item.description: A tram travelling across Marion Road/Cross Road overpass. Trams welcomed passengers back on board from 6.07am on Monday January 26, following weeks of tram testing and driver training.
